description: The file defines the ScannerFragment class for an Android application, responsible for scanning Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) advertisements, filtering by service UUID, displaying results in a list, and managing scan lifecycle tasks such as start and stop.

classes.name: ScannerFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment subclass that performs BLE scanning, filters results, and displays results to the user. Manages lifecycle of BLE scan and UI updates.

methods.name: setBluetoothAdapter
methods.description: Sets the BluetoothAdapter and initializes BluetoothLeScanner.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets options menu, and creates adapter and handler.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view and sets the list adapter.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures ListView appearance and triggers initial scan.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, specifically refresh.

methods.name: startScanning
methods.description: Starts BLE scan with filters and settings, sets timing to stop automatically.

methods.name: buildScanFilters
methods.description: Creates list of ScanFilter objects filtering by specific Service UUID.

methods.name: buildScanSettings
methods.description: Creates ScanSettings object using low power mode.
